content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Plaid ## slug: plaid ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ## What is Plaid? Plaid makes it faster and easier to set up bank payments through a flow designed with the user's experience and security in mind. Users enter their online credentials and Plaid instantly authenticates their account. Plaid works with {{variable.Product_Stripe}} as an ACH processor to simplify bank-to-bank payments. Read more about Plaid [here](https://plaid.com/){target="_blank"}. :::(Warning) (Is your PayLink up to date?) Make sure to upgrade to the latest version of {{variable.Product_PayLink}} before trying to process a Plaid transaction. ::: ## Plaid Setup Prerequisites Please have the following before you start the setup process. * A Plaid account * An activated {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account * For Test Payments - A {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record with {{variable.Field_PG_TestMode}} = "True" that is connected to the activated {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account * For Live Payments - A {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record with {{variable.Field_PG_TestMode}} = "False" that is connected to the activated {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account ## Integrating with Plaid :::(Info) (Prior to Plaid Integration) Make sure your {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account is activated prior to Plaid integration. If you attempt to connect to {{variable.Product_Stripe}} through the Plaid dashboard with a test only {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account you will not be able to move forward until you activate the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} account. ::: 1. Sign up for a [Plaid account,](https://plaid.com/){target="_blank"} if you haven't already done so. 2. Navigate to the "Team Settings" menu in the upper navigation bar. 3. Click **Integrations**. ![H_02_11_integrating with plaid 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_11_integrating%20with%20plaid%201.png){height="" width=""} 4. Select your integration provider (i.e. Stripe). 5. Click **Enable** next to your provider. 6. Follow the steps for enabling the provider. 7. Once integrated you will see the label "ON" in the lower left-hand corner if the provider's icon. ![H_02_11_integrating with plaid 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_11_integrating%20with%20plaid%202.png){height="" width=""} 8. Copy the keys listed in the "Keys" menu in your Plaid dashboard in a safe place. We will use them when we set up your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. ## Add User Permissions 1. Create a new Permission Set in Setup. Name it "Access Encrypted Data." 2. Navigate to System Permissions. 3. Click **Edit**. 4. Set {{variable.Field_PS_ViewEncrptedData}} = "True" (checked). 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 6. Navigate to the user record in Setup for the person who authenticated the Paylink app. This is the person who clicked the **Authenticate** button while running the Paylink setup wizard. 7. Add the permission set you just created to their user record. ## How to Setup Your Payment Gateway :::(Info) (Payment Gateway Setup Notes) * **For testing using test bank data:** Configure your *Test Mode* Stripe Payment Gateway with the {{variable.Field_Plaid_SandboxSecret}} and {{variable.Field_Plaid_ClientID}}. * **When ready for go live and customer use:** Make sure your live Stripe Payment Gateway record has the {{variable.Field_PlaidProductionSecret}} and {{variable.Field_Plaid_ClientID}}. ::: 1. Navigate to a {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} with {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Provider}} = "Stripe." 2. Add your Plaid keys to the {{variable.Field_PG_PlaidUserID}} and {{variable.Field_PG_PlaidSecret}} fields. See the table below for field matching. - **Note:** Once you enable Plaid in Production you will use a different secret key. See the Plaid documentation for [Production Setup](https://plaid.com/docs/launch-checklist/). | Plaid Keys | Payment Gateway Fields | | --- | --- | | {{variable.Field_Plaid_ClientID}} | {{variable.Field_PG_PlaidUserID}} | | {{variable.Field_Plaid_SandboxSecret}} | {{variable.Field_PG_PlaidSecret}} | | {{variable.Field_PlaidProductionSecret}} | {{variable.Field_PG_PlaidSecret}} | 3. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 4. Click **Connect to Gateway** to re-establish a connection with your gateway provider. ## Create a Transaction 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object. 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Select {{variable.Field_Transaction_RecordType}} = "Charge." 4. Click **Next**. 5. Enter the {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} you would like to process through Plaid. (required) 6. Select a {{variable.Field_Transaction_CurrencyISO}}. (required) 7. Set a {{variable.Field_Transaction_PaymentGatew}} with the Stripe gateway that is connected to Plaid. 8. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ## Use PayLink to Process a Plaid Transaction 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Product_PayLink}} section of the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record you just created. 2. Click the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayLink}} URL field. ![H_02_11_integrating with plaid 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_11_integrating%20with%20plaid%203.png){height="" width=""} 3. Observe the {{variable.Product_PayLink}} page. Click **Pay**. ![H_02_11_integrating with plaid 4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_11_integrating%20with%20plaid%204.png){height="" width=""} 4. Click the Bank tab and click **Pay $x.xx**. ![H_02_11_integrating with plaid 5](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_11_integrating%20with%20plaid%205.png){height="" width=""} 5. Choose your bank. ![H_02_11_integrating with plaid 6](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_11_integrating%20with%20plaid%206.png){height="" width=""} 6. Enter your bank credentials. For testing, use username: user_good and password: pass_good. ![H_02_11_integrating with plaid 7](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_11_integrating%20with%20plaid%207.png){height="" width=""} 7. Select a checking or savings account and click **Continue**. ![H_02_11_integrating with plaid 8](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_11_integrating%20with%20plaid%208.png){height="" width=""} 8. If the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} processes successfully, you will see a success message. ![H_02_11_integrating with plaid 9](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_11_integrating%20with%20plaid%209.png){height="" width=""} ## Company Name on the Plaid Consent Screen Ever wondered where Plaid gets the company name used on the consent screen? You can navigate to your Plaid dashboard and customize screens there, or you can do it in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}. :::(Info) (Company Info Object) Make sure you have a {{variable.Object_CompanyInfo}} record that stores the {{variable.Field_CompanyInfo_CompInfoName}} you want to see on the Plaid consent screen. ::: 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record used for Plaid. 2. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} next to the {{variable.Field_PG_CompanyInfo}} field. 3. Select a {{variable.Object_CompanyInfo}} record. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. **NOTE:** You may need to add the {{variable.Field_PG_CompanyInfo}} field to your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} page layout. ![H_02_11_company name on consent screen](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_11_company%20name%20on%20consent%20screen.png){height="" width=""} ## Why Plaid vs ACH * You can use Plaid payment methods for future {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. * You can eliminate the micro deposit verification step. * Plaid offers a direct link to your bank account without having to type in a routing number or account number.
